entry.author: NMITNZ
entry.summary: Join tutor Becs Gibson in a native lowland tōtara forest as she introduces the Foliar Browse Index elective. You’ll learn a quick, practical way to assess canopy health - spotting browse, dieback, and other signs of pest activity - so you can see whether pest control is working and respond early when it’s not. This elective is ideal for those interested in ecological monitoring and pest management and offers a hands-on taste of real conservation mahi and a useful monitoring skill for the workplace.
